partners.mechanism_chain: SLC25A22 (HGNC:13542) —DECREASES→ glutamine (CHEBI:17176); glutamine (CHEBI:17176) —DISRUPTS→ glutamate-glutamine cycle (REACT:R-HSA-1909934); glutamate-glutamine cycle (REACT:R-HSA-1909934) —LEADS_TO→ seizure (HP:0001250); SLC6A3 (HGNC:10604) —DISRUPTS→ dopamine (CHEBI:18349); dopamine (CHEBI:18349) —DISRUPTS→ striatal dopamine signaling (REACT:R-HSA-2016801); striatal dopamine signaling (REACT:R-HSA-2016801) —LEADS_TO→ movement disorder (HP:0001251). Loss-of-function variants in SLC25A22 disrupt the glutamate-glutamine cycle, leading to neuronal hyperexcitability and seizures characteristic of DEE3. Concurrently, loss-of-function variants in SLC6A3 impair dopamine reuptake, disrupting striatal dopamine signaling and causing movement disorders seen in DAT deficiency syndrome. The convergence is hypothesized through impaired excitatory/inhibitory balance in neuronal networks, where altered glutamatergic transmission (from SLC25A22) indirectly impacts dopaminergic pathways (affected by SLC6A3) or vice versa, leading to overlapping neurological deficits.

partners.mechanism_chain: SLC25A22 (HGNC:28439) —DISRUPTS→ Aspartate/Glutamate transport (CHEBI:17628); Aspartate/Glutamate transport (CHEBI:17628) —LEADS_TO→ Mitochondrial function (GO:0005759); Mitochondrial function (GO:0005759) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (HP:0001263); SLC6A5 (HGNC:11178) —DISRUPTS→ Glutamate transport (CHEBI:17628); Glutamate transport (CHEBI:17628) —LEADS_TO→ Glycine receptor signaling (REACT:R-HSA-74740); Glycine receptor signaling (REACT:R-HSA-74740) —LEADS_TO→ Hyperekplexia (HP:0001266).
